verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Postman's API client supports HTTP, GraphQL, and gRPC requests explicitly (postman-docs-31, postman-docs-34 mentions 'multi-protocol requests'), but there is no explicit documented evidence in this pack of WebSocket or SSE request support. missing for 10: explicit documentation of WebSocket request support, explicit documentation of SSE request support, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-protocol usage.
